champion.tips: EZREAL TIPS AND TRICKS Use your abilities as frequently as possible to stack your Tear of the Goddess. The quicker you complete this item- the better. Don’t use your E aggressively unless the enemy has their core abilities on cooldown. Using it aggressively will make it easier for you to get killed if you use it when their abilities are up. To destroy towers quickly and get more gold from tower plates, you can use your W on the tower and follow it up with an auto-attack.
champion.builds: THE BEST EZREAL BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ezreal Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick First Strike as your keystone, followed by Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Solstice Sleigh as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Iceborn Gauntlet. For your last 3 items, you should build Statikk Shiv, Redemption and finish with Liandry's Torment. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 47.4% winrate over 175 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ezreal Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are First Strike as your keystone, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Bloodsong, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Manamune as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Serylda's Grudge, Spear of Shojin and Mortal Reminder. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 30.5% win rate over 82 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Jack Of All Trades in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Solstice Sleigh as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Iceborn Gauntlet as a third item. You want to finish the build with Statikk Shiv, Redemption and Liandry's Torment. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 45.9% win rate across 74 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ezreal Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Press the Attack, Presence of Mind, Legend: Bloodline and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Trinity Force as third item. The last 3 options are Manamune, Spear of Shojin and Zhonya's Hourglass. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 38.8% win rate over 67 matches played. Situational Ezreal Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ezreal build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ezreal runes page.
